video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners that SQL works through a query's clauses in a different order from the one they are written in, using a sales report query that fails

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

strip_wipe.what: Each line of the query is revealed from left to right, one line after another

error_underline_draw.what: A navy underline draws itself under the word 'total' in the filter line

band_enter.what: A lavender band fades in behind the SELECT line of the query

band_step.what: The lavender band slides to the line of the clause that SQL works on next
band_step.scene: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, SELECT, ORDER BY

badge_enter.what: A round violet badge with a step number fades in beside a clause
badge_enter.scene: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, SELECT, ORDER BY

table_tab_light.what: The name tab of the sales table turns from navy to violet

rows_filter_dim.what: The rows from the other year fade from navy to pale gray

rows_regroup.what: The rows of the sales table slide past each other so that rows of the same region sit together

group_outline_draw.what: A navy outline draws itself around each group of rows

group_outline_exit.what: The outlines around the groups fade away

group_rows_exit.what: The extra rows of each group and the filtered rows fade out of the table

total_count.what: The amount in each group's remaining row counts up steadily to the group's total

table_shrink.what: The table gets shorter and each group's row slides up, leaving one row per group

total_header_wipe.what: A violet pill with the word 'total' spreads from left to right over the amount header

year_column_dim.what: The year column fades from navy to pale gray

alias_pill_wipe.what: A lavender highlight spreads from left to right behind the word 'total' at the end of the SELECT line

rows_sort.what: The two rows of the table swap places so the smaller total is on top

strips_reorder.what: The lines of the query slide up and down past each other into the order SQL works through them

order_label_swap.what: The label 'written order' in the card fades out and 'logical order' fades in

reach_line_draw.what: A navy line draws itself from the filter line across and down toward the word 'total' in the SELECT line

reach_cross_draw.what: A navy cross draws itself where that line stops short

reach_exit.what: The navy line and the cross fade away

filter_text_out.what: The filter line's text slides up and fades out

having_text_in.what: The text 'HAVING SUM(amount) > 100' slides up into its place

having_move.what: The HAVING line and the GROUP BY line swap places

badge_renumber.what: The step numbers in the badges of the later clauses change to the next number

check_draw.what: A violet check mark fades in beside the HAVING line

group_dim.what: The row of the group whose total fails the HAVING test fades from navy to pale gray
